content.content: Here's how we put the "SOLD" in Fresh Rolls:

## <center> Ensure that you've put the correct label signage.
## <center> The labels need to be up to date and laminated.

## <center> Display fridge glass has to be clean and free of fingerprints and dust.
There should be no cling wraps in the display fridge, and Fresh rolls should not be double stacked.
